question: Should ClawHub preserve lowercase and legacy skill readme compatibility while rejecting only case-colliding duplicate paths, and is `PROTOCOL.md` in scope for the skill package contract?
rationale: The current public docs and publish/import code intentionally accept lowercase aliases, while the report also asks about a `PROTOCOL.md` file that is not currently part of the ClawHub skill format.

options.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
options.body: Keep `SKILL.md`, `skill.md`, and `skills.md` compatibility, reject packages that contain case-colliding duplicates, and document the cleanup rule.

options.title: Adopt uppercase-only
options.body: Make `SKILL.md` the only accepted readme spelling, but require an explicit migration and release-note plan for existing lowercase users.

options.title: Limit scope to SKILL files
options.body: Resolve the readme collision bug now and defer any `PROTOCOL.md` contract decision to a separate product discussion.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
recommendation.body: Keep `SKILL.md`, `skill.md`, and `skills.md` compatibility, reject packages that contain case-colliding duplicates, and document the cleanup rule.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current-history owner for the released docs and validation surfaces that define the compatibility contract.
